svg.aria-label: S13 Execute: six integer pipelines and the bypass network
svg.text: S13 Execute: six integer pipelines and the bypass network
An operand comes from the register file read ports or straight off a result bus. The player lights the unit, the operand mux input that won and the result.
, one scheduler queue in front of each
Ports per bank are not published.
A result reaches any operand mux next cycle.
A lit tap means the operand came off a result bus.
A lit read port means it came from the register file.
Results also write the register file, which S2 draws.
The latencies are from ocxtal's and Dougall's measurements.
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
